simple.meaning: מְרוּצָה (mᵉrûwtsâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a race (the act), whether the manner or the progress.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מְרוּצָה (H4794) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Samuel 18:27, with occurrences in 2 Samuel, Jeremiah.

definitions.short: a race (the act), whether the manner or the progress
definitions.full: H4794. merutsah I. [ מְרוּצָה ] noun feminine 1. running . 2 course (of life): — 1 running, mode, style, of running , construct מְרוּצַת 2Sam 18:27 , מְרֻצַת 18:27 . 2 course (of life), suffix מְרוּצָתָם Jer 8:6 (Qr; > Kt plural מרצותם ), 23:10 . — II. מְרוּצָה 22:17 see below רצץ .
